mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_dev_request_test_result (dev_request_id, kind, tc_id, title, actual, verdict, raw_verdict, evidence, received_at) values (#{devRequestId}, #{result.kind}, #{result.tcId}, #{result.title}, #{result.actual}, #{result.verdict}, #{result.rawVerdict}, #{result.evidence}, now()) on conflict (dev_request_id, tc_id) do update set kind = excluded.kind, title = excluded.title, actual = excluded.actual, verdict = excluded.verdict, raw_verdict = excluded.raw_verdict, evidence = excluded.evidence, received_at = now()
mapper.select: select dev_request_id, kind, tc_id, title, actual, verdict, raw_verdict, evidence, received_at from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_test_result where dev_request_id = #{devRequestId} order by kind, tc_id
